original: I wouldn't start everyone off on the general "gut cleanse" stacks either, the ones built around oregano oil, wormwood, black walnut, berberine or other antimicrobial herbs. Those are for later (Phase 3), once you have more reason to suspect overgrowth, parasites, H. pylori or something else specific. (My own advice is different for H. pylori, where berberine works well: see Parasites, above.)
rewrite: You'll also find "gut cleanse" stacks, built around oregano oil, wormwood, black walnut, berberine or other antimicrobial herbs, but I wouldn't start everyone off on those. They kill bugs, and that's Phase 3, for when changing your diet hasn't cleared your symptoms and you have more reason to suspect overgrowth, parasites, H. pylori or something else specific. For H. pylori, though, my own advice is to use berberine, which works well for it (see Parasites, above).

original: Start with low doses, especially of prebiotics, resistant starch, butyrate-support products and probiotics. And if you have severe pain, GI bleeding, fever, dehydration, rapid weight loss, an active IBD flare, cancer, immune suppression, a pregnancy, or another complex medical condition, don't stack supplements on your own, work with a qualified clinician instead.
rewrite: Start with low doses, especially of prebiotics, resistant starch, butyrate-support products and probiotics, since they feed or add gut bacteria, and doing that too fast can give you gas and bloating, then build up as your gut gets used to them. And if you have severe pain, bleeding from your gut, fever, dehydration, rapid weight loss, an active IBD flare, cancer, immune suppression, a pregnancy, or another complex medical condition, the first few can be signs of something that needs a doctor, and the rest can change what's safe for you to take, so work with a qualified clinician instead of stacking supplements on your own.
